description: acc_summaries summary-car speed: constant-velocity Kalman filter on the radar's 0x190 cycle clock (process noise 0.05 m^2/s^3, measurement = middle of the 1/16 m range step) against the former least-squares slope of the last 8 ranges over CAN time. Accuracy on the ACC car's own summary, against the ACC target's REL_SPEED from the same tracker (radar-witness authority); replay on unchanged openpilot radard + planner.
source: workspace experiments SCR-1095..1097 and the compact filter replay QSP (ars510_accsum_quantized_speed_20261020)
